CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `email` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `country` char(2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_email` (`email`),
  KEY `k_country` (`country`),
  KEY `k_created_unused` (`created`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `products` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `sku` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `price` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_sku` (`sku`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=4 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `orders` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `customer_id` int NOT NULL,
  `placed` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_status` (`status`),
  KEY `fk_cust` (`customer_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cust` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `order_items` (
  `order_id` int NOT NULL,
  `product_id` int NOT NULL,
  `qty` int DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_id`,`product_id`),
  KEY `fk_p` (`product_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_o` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `orders` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_p` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `products` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `kinds` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'the row',
  `tiny` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `small` smallint(5) unsigned zerofill DEFAULT NULL,
  `money` decimal(18,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.0000',
  `ratio` double DEFAULT NULL,
  `born` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `seen` datetime(6) DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `stamp` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `yr` year DEFAULT NULL,
  `t` time(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET latin1 COLLATE latin1_swedish_ci NOT NULL,
  `note` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `blob_` blob,
  `bits` bit(8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('new','paid','shipped') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
  `flags` set('a','b','c') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `doc` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `shape` geometry NOT NULL,
  `name_upper` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GENERATED ALWAYS AS (upper(`name`)) VIRTUAL,
  `money_cents` bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((`money` * 100)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_name` (`name`),
  KEY `k_status_seen` (`status`,`seen`),
  KEY `k_note` (`note`(20)),
  SPATIAL KEY `sp_shape` (`shape`),
  FULLTEXT KEY `ft_note` (`note`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1000 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='every column type'

CREATE TABLE `parent` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `code` char(3) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_code` (`code`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `child` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `parent_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `parent_code` char(3) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_parent` (`parent_id`),
  KEY `fk_code` (`parent_code`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_code` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_code`) REFERENCES `parent` (`code`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_parent` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_id`) REFERENCES `parent` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `by_range` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `d` date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`,`d`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
/*!50100 PARTITION BY RANGE (year(`d`))
(PARTITION p2024 VALUES LESS THAN (2025) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION p2025 VALUES LESS THAN (2026) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION pmax VALUES LESS THAN MAXVALUE ENGINE = InnoDB) */

CREATE TABLE `by_list` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `region` int NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`,`region`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
/*!50100 PARTITION BY LIST (`region`)
(PARTITION p_east VALUES IN (1,2) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION p_west VALUES IN (3,4) ENGINE = InnoDB) */

CREATE TABLE `by_key_sub` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `d` date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`,`d`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
/*!50100 PARTITION BY RANGE (year(`d`))
SUBPARTITION BY HASH (`id`)
SUBPARTITIONS 2
(PARTITION a VALUES LESS THAN (2025) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION b VALUES LESS THAN MAXVALUE ENGINE = InnoDB) */

CREATE TABLE `myisam_log` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `msg` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci PACK_KEYS=1 CHECKSUM=1 DELAY_KEY_WRITE=1

CREATE TABLE `merged` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `msg` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=MRG_MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci INSERT_METHOD=LAST UNION=(`myisam_log`)

CREATE TABLE `modern` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `qty` int NOT NULL DEFAULT (1),
  `price` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `secret` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL /*!80023 INVISIBLE */,
  `tags` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `created` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_desc` (`created` DESC,`id`),
  KEY `k_hidden` (`price`) /*!80000 INVISIBLE */,
  KEY `k_lower` ((lower(`secret`))),
  KEY `k_tags` ((cast(json_extract(`tags`,_latin1'$[*]') as unsigned array))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_price` CHECK ((`price` >= 0)) /*!80016 NOT ENFORCED */,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_qty` CHECK ((`qty` > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
